## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -18.23%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND show risk appetite, but HYG/LQD credit stress ↑ (Credit Spread 0.7372 1W: +0.20% | 1M: +1.24%) offsets — net neutral.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -18.23%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit stress RISING: HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +1.40%) NEUTRAL and LQD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +0.34%) CORRECTION imply HYG/LQD ↑. Stocks vs Bonds showing risk tilt: SPY/TLT (Stocks vs Bonds level 8.4178) ↑ rising with SPY (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-supportive: UUP (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -1.15%) BELOW TREND → flat dollar and Yield Curve (Level 1.0409) → flat BELOW TREND; TLT (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -0.39%) BELOW TREND signals rates pressure but not extreme.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +37.58%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing strength: XLF proxy (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +6.97%) ABOVE TREND. Style: Growth/Momentum leading.

**5. US vs Global?**
US and broad EM outperforming: SPY (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +0.61% | 1M: +12.06%) ABOVE TREND; China FXI (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +3.52%) in CORRECTION — mixed EM internals.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation intact but watchful: IWM (1W: +0.95% | 1M: +11.91%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +15.09%) ABOVE TREND; Speculation Index in CORRECTION (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +2.10%) signals short‑term pullback risk.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity bifurcation: Oil ETFs USO (1W: +7.85% | 1M: +15.08%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND showing strength, while GLD (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND and CPER (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +5.50%) in CORRECTION signal mixed cyclical demand.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy firming: XLE (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.20%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: +3.88% | 1M: -6.22%) RECOVERY but remains volatile.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech/semis — XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +15.38%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: several cyclicals (XLY 1W: -0.05% | 1M: +8.04% CORRECTION, CPER CORRECTION) show 1W vs 1M mismatches but severity = MINOR.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor Growth/Momentum exposure via XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +15.38%) ABOVE TREND; monitor credit stress HYG/LQD (Credit Spread 0.7372 1W: +0.20% | 1M: +1.24%) and reduce exposure to gold GLD (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology — XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND; Energy — XLE (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.20%) RECOVERY / BNO (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Materials (sector breadth weak; Materials 1W: -2.03% | 1M: +2.52% BELOW TREND) and Consumer Discretionary in short-term CORRECTION XLY (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +8.04%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Crude — USO (1W: +7.85% | 1M: +15.08%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND and Copper CPER (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +5.50%) CORRECTION.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (current VXX 28.40 — complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.74 (current Credit Spread 0.7372 — monitor for widening), XLK/XLF tech vs financials ratio ~3.1 (current 3.1177) as style pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, VXX (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -18.23%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND offset by rising credit stress HYG/LQD (Credit Spread 0.7372 1W: +0.20% | 1M: +1.24%). Technology and semis (XLK 1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%; SOXX 1W: +0.90% | 1M: +37.58%) showing strength; key risk is credit stress widening and minor 1W/1M divergences in cyclicals (CPER, XLY) to monitor.
